body: Farmers market haul. I went for eggs and came back with five kinds of apples and no eggs.
First loaf from the new starter!! Crust came out way better than I expected. Crumb is a little tight but I'm not telling the bread that.
Long shift done. Grateful for the coworkers who made it bearable. Going to sleep for 11 hours now, do not text me
Does anybody know why the water was brown for a few minutes this morning? Ran it a while and it cleared up.
Sunday dinner for twelve. Eggplant parm, two trays, and they still asked if there was more. Recipe in the comments if anyone wants it.
Does anyone know a good repair shop for espresso machines? Mine is making a terrible noise. Like a goose.
Potluck at the community center this Friday, 6pm. Sign up sheet is by the front desk. We have 4 desserts and zero main dishes so far, people.
Cheddar biscuits, test batch #2 for friday. They spread more than I wanted but they taste right
Club 5K this Saturday, 8am at the park pavilion. All paces welcome, walkers too. Bring a friend!
found a grey cat hanging around the bike racks behind the library. no collar, very friendly, very loud. anyone missing one??
Got up early to shoot the sunrise and it was cloudy. So here is the consolation prize instead.
My daughter lost her first tooth today and asked if the tooth fairy takes cards.
First tomato of the year. My neighbor said they'd never ripen. Well.
Mom turned 70 today!! She said no fuss. We fussed.
Reminder that the library book sale is this weekend. Paperbacks are 50 cents. I am not responsible for what happens to your shelves.
Trying to eat more greens this month. Day 4 and still going. Chopping all this took longer than eating it
Grill's going. Come by if you're around, there's plenty
Who else thinks pineapple belongs on pizza? Asking for a friend.
Whoever keeps leaving their dog's bags ON TOP of the bin instead of in it. Why. The lid opens.
Challah for the potluck. Second try at the braid, the first one looked like a shoelace
update on library cat: he belongs to the house on the corner, his name is Gus, and apparently he does this to everyone
Roast chicken in a foil pan because I am not washing a roasting dish tonight.
Made my mother's chocolate bundt for the potluck and it didn't even make it to Friday. Somebody in this house got into it.
Evening walk down by the creek. Counted 3 herons and one guy fishing who did not want to chat.
Post long run pancakes. Yes that is banana on top. No I will not be sharing.
Found the repair shop. Machine is fixed and so is my mood.
Farm stand out on the county road has corn already. Got a dozen. Finally.
Funeral potatoes for tomorrow. Yes that's what they're called. No, nobody died.
ramen place by campus finally reopened. spicy miso. I've missed you
What a turnout last night. Thank you to everybody who cooked, carried tables and stayed to stack chairs. Same time next month?
Great turnout at the 5K. 41 people and 3 dogs. Thanks to everyone who came out.
